The '''Ruloosia system''' was located in the [[Oktos sector/Legends|Oktos sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creature]] known as the [[Ruloosian sand-snake]].<ref name="SWC11" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ruloosia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square R-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
